contentFull:
Rometron establishes WEED-IT USA to expand spot spraying support

 13-08 | Crop solutions | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Rometron is expanding its presence in the United States with a dedicated subsidiary for its WEED-IT precision spot spraying technology. WEED-IT uses optical sensors to detect vegetation and trigger individual spray nozzles in real time. Photo: Martin Smits

Dutch precision spraying specialist Rometron has established a US subsidiary to expand sales and support for its WEED-IT spot spraying technology.

WEED-IT USA will be based in Wellington, Colorado, and will focus on distribution, service and technical support across the United States. The new subsidiary builds on Rometron’s existing cooperation with AgriTech America, which has been distributing WEED-IT systems to US growers. According to Rometron, existing customers and dealers will continue to receive support through their established contacts during the transition.

Real-time weed detection

WEED-IT uses optical sensors to detect living plant material and activate individual spray nozzles in real time. This allows herbicide to be applied only where vegetation is detected rather than across the full field width. The technology is particularly used for green-on-brown applications, such as controlling weeds in fallow fields.

Rometron, headquartered in Steenderen, the Netherlands, sees further growth opportunities for precision spraying in the US market and says the new operation should provide more direct local technical and dealer support. Doug Daws has been appointed general manager of WEED-IT USA. He has more than 30 years of experience in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture, including positions at Caterpillar, AGCO, CNH Industrial and Trimble.

translationZh:
荷兰精准喷洒专家Rometron已在美国设立子公司，以扩大其WEED-IT点喷除草技术的销售与支持。

WEED-IT USA将设在科罗拉多州惠灵顿，专注于美国境内的分销、服务和技术支持。新子公司建立在Rometron与AgriTech America现有合作的基础上，后者一直向美国种植者分销WEED-IT系统。据Rometron称，在过渡期间，现有客户和经销商将继续通过其既有联系人获得支持。

**实时杂草检测**

WEED-IT使用光学传感器实时检测活体植物材料，并独立激活各个喷头。这样，除草剂仅在检测到植被的地方施用，而不是在整个田宽上喷洒。该技术特别适用于绿色-棕色应用，例如在休耕地中控制杂草。

Rometron总部位于荷兰斯滕德伦，认为美国市场在精准喷洒方面有进一步增长机会，并表示新运营机构应提供更直接的本地技术和经销商支持。Doug Daws已被任命为WEED-IT USA的总经理。他在农业机械和精准农业领域拥有超过30年的经验，曾在Caterpillar、AGCO、CNH Industrial和Trimble任职。
author: Geert Hekkert
